name: Evan Simpson
education: B.S. in engineering, University of Wyoming
prior_offices: Wyoming House District 21, 2017–2022; Lincoln County North Hospital District trustee (as listed in the 2021–22 legislative directory)
background: Evan Simpson of Afton served in the Wyoming House from 2017 to 2022, representing House District 21. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born Feb. 11, 1957, in Afton; listed a B.S. in engineering from the University of Wyoming; and identified him as a retired consulting civil engineer. It also listed service as a trustee of the Lincoln County North Hospital District, and said he was married to his wife, Bev, and had six children and 18 grandchildren.

sources.name: Wyoming Trucking Association and Associated General Contractors of Wyoming, 2021–2022 Directory of the Sixty-Sixth Legislature
